(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((h (obj-h obj)) (w (obj-w obj))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                         (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define (transform shape key)
      (if (= key 1) shape (if (= key 2) (rotate-cw shape) (if (= key 3) (rotate-180 shape) (rotate-ccw shape)))))
    (define objs (objects g 0))
    (define frames (filter frame? objs))
    (define inserts (filter (lambda (obj) (and (not (frame? obj)) (> (obj-size obj) 1))) objs))
    (define singles (filter (lambda (obj) (and (= (obj-size obj) 1) (member (obj-color obj) (list 1 2 3 4)))) objs))
    (define with-frames
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([fr (in-list frames)])
        (paint-cells out (obj-cells fr) (obj-color fr))))
    (for/fold ([out with-frames]) ([fr (in-list frames)])
      (let* ((key-candidates (filter (lambda (s)
                                       (let ((p (first (obj-cells s))))
                                         (and (> (first p) (obj-r1 fr)) (< (first p) (obj-r2 fr))
                                              (> (second p) (obj-c1 fr)) (< (second p) (obj-c2 fr)))))
                                     singles))
             (key (if (empty? key-candidates) 1 (obj-color (first key-candidates))))
             (insert (first (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) (obj-color fr))) inserts)))
             (shape (transform (subgrid g (obj-r1 insert) (obj-c1 insert) (obj-r2 insert) (obj-c2 insert)) key)))
        (for*/fold ([acc out])
                   ([r (in-range (rows shape))]
                    [c (in-range (cols shape))])
          (let ((v (at shape r c)))
            (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc (+ (obj-r1 fr) 1 r) (+ (obj-c1 fr) 1 c) v) acc)))))))
